text_read: full text of 3.4-3.7, 3.10, Ch. 5 (Seeing), Ch. 7.1-7.12 (Seeing 2), 9.9 and 10.7 (Opus, rereading the saved text); remaining chapters from the digest
mode_evidence: Closed-eye work is perceptual: 'no imagination, no visualisation' and the light is 'spiritual light, perceived with your eyes closed', from whitish haze to colours, shining particles and the purple 'space'. The open-eye chapters place what is seen in the visual field itself: during eye contact the physical image blurs and distorts, halos and colours appear, the partner's face is replaced by another, and the room 'appears darker' with a glowing semi-darkness he identifies with the purple light seen behind closed eyes (5.7). Sagan reads these as astral rather than physical perception, but his instructions are about where and how it is seen: in front of the open eyes, and only once ordinary sharp-outlined vision is let go (5.9-5.11).
onset_evidence: Closed-eye ladder: find any vibration between the eyebrows with throat friction, then look for any fog, haze or glow there and connect the friction to it. 3.5, for those who feel nothing: the vibration may be unregistered because one expects too much or tries too hard; or one may already be getting light, which bypasses the vibration ('If you are perceiving light in any form ... then you are already in the astral'); he has never seen a student fail after a bit of practice. Open-eye induction: eye contact with a partner or mirror (motionless focus in the brow, blinking as little as possible, attention to 'seeingness' rather than the image) for 3 to 5 minutes, building to 15 or more, in candlelight against a blank wall; the image blurs and colours appear. Ending each round by palming, 'you will have momentous experiences of inner light' (5.5). Where seeingness cannot be found, 'feel the image instead of looking at it'. Night walks without a torch: dirt paths and objects glow (7.1), 'typically one of those perceptions that most people miss'. No grace or transmission requirement.

conditions.posture: first opening lying down; meditation sitting with spine vertical, still
conditions.gaze_or_eye_position: eyes closed for the meditation; eyeballs never turned toward the brow (awareness only); in eye contact, gaze at the partner's eye, brow centre or the space in front, or 1-2 inches above the head for auras; blink as little as possible
conditions.setting: candles or oil lamps rather than electric light; blank white or very light wall; partner 90 cm away at eye height, or a mirror; semi-darkness indoors, never outdoors in daylight; white shawl
conditions.duration_and_schedule: 30-minute meditation, about 5 minutes per phase; eye contact 3 to 5 minutes rising to 15 or more, each round preceded by a 2-3 minute closed-eye 'reconnection' and ended with palming
conditions.other: throat friction: soft laryngeal breathing sound kept up through the phases

stages.label: vibration (etheric)
stages.description: tingling, pressure, density between the eyebrows; may be bypassed if light comes first

stages.label: light (astral)
stages.description: haze, cloud, glow, colours, shining particles and patterns between the eyebrows, brightened by the throat friction

stages.label: purple space
stages.description: the dark or purple background behind the lights, entered as a space; relief in the heart (3.10)

stages.label: blurring and astral colour (open eyes)
stages.description: in eye contact the sharp image blurs, vision widens to the periphery, colours made of 'tiny hyper-brilliant points' and halos appear; the partner seems far away; faces change

stages.label: astral light in the room
stages.description: the room suddenly appears darker though it is day: a glowing semi-darkness, the same purple light seen with eyes closed; later physical and non-physical seen together

what_to_do_with_light: Closed eyes: connect the throat friction to the brightest part, then rest in the purple space. Open eyes: let the image blur rather than refocus; when 'something inside' grasps and the sharp outlines snap back, relax into the brow and seeingness and let it blur again, watching the grasping itself (5.9-5.10). Do not analyse visions while they occur; draw them afterwards; attend to the fact of seeing rather than content (5.8). Connecting the friction to halos enhances them (7.5).
obstacles_and_fixes: grasping or concentrating blocks the process: stay vacant
sensation elsewhere in the face: ignore and stay between the eyebrows
faint or blurry light: accept as first thread and keep practising
thoughts: do not fight, return to the eye or intensify throat friction
image snaps back to sharp outlines (the mind 'grasping'): relax, return to the brow and to seeingness; the perception returns
seeingness unclear: feel the image instead of looking at it, including the space around the partner
frequent blinking on some days, 'as if you had a cloud of toxic smoke' before the eyes: accept the fluctuation and keep practising
pressure in the brow becoming a headache: stop grasping; or the energy is pulling upward, so move awareness above the head (10.7-10.8)
progress blocked: do some channel release (7.7)
cautions: no gazing at the Sun under any circumstances; no unblinking moon-gazing; no eye contact outdoors in daylight (5.2)
faces seen may be guides, past lives, sub-personalities or attached entities, or one's own projection: do not interpret early (5.8)
the 'Atlantean climax' variant builds power without compassion and is not for regular practice (5.12)
do not attach meaning to minor tingling and flashes
interpretation: Light between the eyebrows marks the astral layer of the third eye; the purple space is the astral space, and the glowing darkness seen with open eyes is the occultists' 'astral light'. Sharp ordinary vision is the mind's construction, a 'cramp'; the fluid light and colour behind it is nearer reality (5.11).
practice_summary: Sit straight, eyes closed, breathing with a soft friction in the throat. Find any vibration between the eyebrows and join the friction to it; then look there for haze, glow or colour, however faint, and connect the friction to the brightest part; then rest in the purple or dark space behind. No visualising. For open-eye work, sit 90 cm from a partner or a mirror, by candlelight against a blank wall. After two or three minutes of this closed-eye reconnection, open the eyes on the partner's eyes: stay motionless with awareness in the brow, blink as little as possible, and attend to the fact of seeing rather than the image. Let the image blur and distort; colours, halos, a darkened room or changed faces may appear. When the sharp image snaps back, relax and let it go again. After 3 to 15 minutes, close the eyes, rub the hands and palm the eyes for half a minute, where inner light is common.

key_passages.anchor: Observe if any feeling of light or colours can be perceived between
key_passages.paraphrase: After stopping the throat friction, stay extremely still and watch for light or colour between the eyebrows.

key_passages.anchor: Remember, no imagination, no visualisation – just awareness of
key_passages.paraphrase: Light is to be perceived, not imagined: it is spiritual light seen with the eyes closed.

key_passages.anchor: Most of the students who think they can't see the light actually
key_passages.paraphrase: Most who think they cannot see the light do see it but do not recognise it; a faint whitish haze is the first thread, to be developed with the amplifying throat friction.

key_passages.anchor: A common experience is that of tiny shining particles of light,
key_passages.paraphrase: Tiny shining particles drifting in the space in front are a common experience; the friction is connected to the most luminous part.

key_passages.locator: 3.5 If you are not feeling any vibration at all
key_passages.anchor: it may be that you are getting light instead of vibration
key_passages.paraphrase: Someone who feels no vibration may already be perceiving light, any form of it from a blurry whitish haze to purple, and should simply work with the light instead.

key_passages.locator: 5.5 To end any practice of eye contact
key_passages.anchor: During this phase, you will have momentous experiences of inner light
key_passages.paraphrase: Each eye-contact round ends by rubbing the hands and palming the closed eyes for half a minute or more, a phase in which inner light is said to come strongly.

key_passages.locator: 5.7 A few common experiences while practising eye contact
key_passages.anchor: The room in which you are practising appears darker, the quality of the colours changes
key_passages.paraphrase: With open eyes the room can suddenly look darker even by day; this glowing semi-darkness is the 'astral light', the same as the purple light seen when meditating with closed eyes.

key_passages.locator: 5.9 Watching the graspings of the mind
key_passages.anchor: From time to time, something seems to retract inside yourself
key_passages.paraphrase: In eye contact the image blurs and colours appear, until something inside retracts and the sharp physical image snaps back; relaxing into the brow and seeingness lets the blur and colours return, and the blurred mode also widens vision to the periphery.

key_passages.anchor: if you walk on a dirt path in the countryside at night, you will often discover that the path glows
key_passages.paraphrase: Walking at night without artificial light, aware in the brow, objects and dirt paths often show a glow; he calls this easy and commonly missed.
